trigger_contract.rule: Byte-identical names and types. Never rename, retype or reorder. Verified 2026-10-09.

vocabularies._rule: One vocabulary per select the gate reasons about. The Notion option name is authoritative and is never renamed; option IDs are recorded so a rename or re-creation is detectable. Agent enums map to Notion names here and nowhere else. A Notion write carries the exact Notion name (Notion would silently create a new option from an agent enum). A value found in neither column is unknown and fails closed.

workflow._rule: Corrected 2026-10-09 (owner correction brief). Each stage needs the one before it. A human acts at every gate; no agent or skill passes one.
design_path: Strategic DRAGON (DB5) -> Editorial DRAGON (DB6) -> brief copy at Version N (DB7)
G1 concept review + readiness check on Version N (human) -> human sets Publishing Status = Ready for Design
Creative Pipeline routine: storyboard + production plan comment for Version N (planning only)
Human spend approval for Version N before any generation or credit spend (Design 19)
Design produces the finished artifact (asset IDs + versions)
G2 on the exact finished artifact: copy at Version N + the asset set (human) -> human publishes
text_only_path: Strategic DRAGON -> Editorial DRAGON -> final copy at Version N
G1 concept review on Version N, path = text_only (human). Required: text-only skips Design and spend approval, never G1 (hardening unit, owner direction).
G2 on the exact final copy at Version N (human) -> human publishes.
workflow.text_only_rule: Genuinely text-only = a text-capable format AND empty (or 'text-only') Visual Direction and Canva Instructions AND no assets AND a human G1 recording path text_only. A text-capable format alone is never asset-free.
workflow.evidence_binding: Every stage record (G1, storyboard, spend approval, claim review, asset provenance, G2 submission) names the brief ID and the revision it covers. Another brief, another revision, or no identity is refused (R12, R20, R24). Assets: a registry-token ID (never a URL), a whole-number version >= 1, listed once, and provenance {brief_id, brief_revision} (R25).
workflow.g1_record: No Notion property exists for G1. Until one is approved (proposal: 04_Content/APPROVAL_EVIDENCE_STORAGE_PROPOSAL.md), G1 is a dated page-body line on the brief written or quoted from the human reviewer: 'G1 passed | brief <page id> | rev N | path design|text_only | <reviewer> | <date>'.
workflow.spend_approval_record: Owned by Design (19) and the approval matrix (Creative Pipeline: human gate before credit spend). Content's gate checks only that one exists for the same brief ID and Version.
workflow.g2_artifact_record: No Notion property holds the approved asset set. Until one is approved (same proposal), the G2 packet on the brief page lists it (asset ID, version, provenance), and the publication record must reproduce it exactly.

fields.name: Version
fields.note: A positive integer, never empty. A new brief starts at 1. Any publication-affecting change is a VERSION that sets exactly prior + 1; no change, no bump. A G1 pass, a spend approval and a G2 approval each bind to one Version. Notion returns it as a float (1.0); the gate accepts integral values only.
